objective.name: matter.subscription.ack
objective.description: Acknowledge one durably delivered Matter event.

#root.role: Advance one durable subscription after its current event has been processed.

removed._comment: False for an already acknowledged or unknown event, making ack idempotent.

effects.outbox: The acknowledged pending entry is removed atomically and the next event for the subscription becomes deliverable.

transformation_contract.morphing: A stable delivery identity advances an at-least-once subscription cursor.
invariants: Delivery is at-least-once; consumers deduplicate with event_id.
success: Repeated acknowledgements are successful idempotent no-ops.
failure: Missing identifiers or an outbox persistence error fail the request.
